label: Save paper summary version
description: Save a citation-grounded summary as an immutable version. Complete review status requires contiguous full source coverage; otherwise the reviewed-mode version is explicitly partial. Overview-mode versions remain separate and never replace canonical summary.md. Use once after evidence review, reserving a save turn even when the budget cannot cover the whole paper. A final outstanding batch can be checkpointed by this save. Identical replay returns the original version; different content cannot overwrite it. Reviewed mode updates canonical summary.md only if it has not changed since the dedicated job began. User notes are never modified.

parameter_descriptions.document_id: The exact local document ID being summarized.
parameter_descriptions.content: The reviewed summary Markdown with page/chunk citations; explicitly state unread coverage and limits when partial.
parameter_descriptions.review_summary: A concise record of the reviewer checks completed and any remaining evidence limitations.
